transfer.stem: Which report matches the model-room notes?
transfer.passage:
Setting up the model room
Before our club opened the model room, we wrote neat labels that were easy to read. We kept one workspace tidy so that tools would be easier to find. After the art activity, the other table was messy, with materials scattered over it. The photograph showed the mess; the written note told us when it was there.
For a small model, the instructions said to straighten the wire before attaching the wheel. We followed that order. First we made the wire straight, and only then did we attach the wheel.
A visitor’s curly hair showed from under her cap as she looked at a model. A bald man wore a hat while he stood in the sun. We recorded what we saw, without guessing why he was bald.
We arranged the chairs in an oval for the discussion. Later, when everyone stood up, the teacher asked us to stand in a circle around the model. The two arrangements happened at different times. Neither instruction specified how many chairs or people there were.

options.text: The wire was straightened before the wheel was attached; chairs formed an oval; people later stood in a circle around the model.
The wheel was attached before the wire was straightened; chairs formed an oval; people later stood in a circle around the model.
The wire was straightened before the wheel was attached; exactly eight chairs were bought; people later stood in a circle around the model.
The wire was straightened before the wheel was attached; chairs formed an oval; the sunlight was recorded as the cause of the man’s hair loss.

answer.display: The wire was straightened before the wheel was attached; chairs formed an oval; people later stood in a circle around the model.
